table_cell_pairs.en: This PCR covers buses and coaches rented with an operator for a period of time, generally not dependent on distance; the renter determines how and when the vehicles operate, including schedules, routes and other operational considerations. The supplied product is actual operated vehicle availability under the original hire obligation. Reference is one independently completed and accepted hire engagement with declared positive actual accepted availability time, vehicle or originally specified fleet, configuration, capacity, operator responsibilities, region/duty and delivery/redelivery gates. Permitted standby can fulfill availability with no passengers or distance. Unlike duration/capacity/control/duty profiles are not equivalent merely because each engagement counts as one.
table_cell_pairs.zh: 本PCR覆盖配操作驾驶员按一段时间出租巴士及客车，通常不依赖距离；承租方决定车辆如何何时运行及班次路线其他运行事项。所供产品是按原租用义务提供真实带操作车辆可用性。参考为一次独立完成验收租用约定，声明正值真实验收可用时间、车辆或原定车队配置容量操作责任区域作业交还车端口。允许待命可无乘客无距离而履行可用。不同租时容量控制作业画像不能因各计一项就等价。

table_cell_pairs.en: Exclude local/urban/suburban bus or coach charter services 64118 and long-distance charter 64223, passenger carriage sold as transport, vehicle hire without operator, operator-only labour and asset manufacture. A monthly invoice, whole-vehicle booking, driver presence, distance charge or fuel payer alone does not establish operated rental; verify the actual immediate supplied function and renter operational direction. Independent downstream passenger service remains separate. Actual driver work, preparation, accepted standby, positioning, failure/recovery/replacement and required support stay inside the causal rental boundary. No universal hire, legal, vehicle-size or driver-hours clause is imposed.
table_cell_pairs.zh: 排除本地城市郊区巴士客车包车服务64118及长途包车64223、作为运输销售的客运、无驾驶员车辆租用、仅操作劳动及资产制造。月账单全车预订驾驶员存在距离收费燃料付款人不能独定带操作租赁；核实真实直接供应功能及承租方运行指令。独立下游客运分开。真实驾驶员工作准备合格待命调位失败救援替车必要支持仍在因果租用边界。不强制通用租约法律车大小驾驶时限条款。

table_cell_pairs.en: Include actual driver/operator work and necessary dispatch/preparation/inspection, active operation, owed standby, depot/customer delivery/redelivery positioning, layover, cleaning, breakdown/search/recovery, unavailable duties and actual accepted replacement. Record renter schedule/route directions and provider driver/maintenance/safety responsibilities without implying unsafe unrestricted control. Actual readiness/HVAC/thermal/charging and ancillary loads remain even with no passengers. Human support uses real owed supplies/services without invented metabolic/diet factors.
table_cell_pairs.zh: 含真实驾驶操作工作必要调度准备检验运行应待命车库客户交还车调位停留清洗故障搜救不可用责任真实验收替车。记录承租班次路线指令与供应驾驶维护安全责任，不意味着不受限危险控制。真实准备空调热充电辅助负荷无乘客仍保留。人支持按真实应承担供应服务，不虚构代谢饮食因子。

Actual diesel/electric/hybrid/gaseous/other propulsion is recorded, not all assumed present. Internal power/recovered material not a new purchased product.

table_cell_pairs.en: Actual hire/subhire/driver-support/charging/cleaning/maintenance/recovery/treatment and infrastructure providers keep their native function/unit/gates and covered phases/events/sites/periods. Replace exact matching own supply/direct/life cells once; all required gaps remain. Neither subcontracting nor a fuel-included invoice proves full life or removes renter-paid energy. No duplicate final passenger carriage and rental output for one supplied obligation.

table_cell_pairs.en: Use mutually exclusive opening/receipt/closing/use/return/recovered outward/waste/environment terms. Internal recovery not extra receipt/use/outward; recovered material is only retained, actually later used or sent to one destination. Distinguish actual supplied water, direct withdrawal, recirculation, runoff and evaporative consumption; actual source/receiving compartment and native state govern. Collected real mixtures may remain one identified waste stream, not all constituent mass emitted or automatic recycling credit.
table_cell_pairs.zh: 库存接收期末使用返还回收外运废物环境项互斥，内部回收不另加接收使用外运；回收物只留存真实后用或一个目的。区分供应水直接取用循环径流蒸发耗用，按真实来源接收子介质原生状态。真实收集混合物可一已识别废物流，不全组分排放或自动循环信用。
mandatory_atomic_completion

table_cell_pairs.en: Every cp_expand_ is a mandatory node-owned collection requirement outside inventory. For each real event require occurrence or evidenced absence and an exhaustive child register; each actual child has unique row, single identifiable product/formulation/assembly/functional service/collected waste/substance or particle fraction, actual direction/type/state/gate/native property/unit/quantity/source/same-node protocol, verified UUID, receiver and all-user/provider coverage. Split independently identified alternatives and environmental compartments; never bind a requirement label, generic exhaust/NOx/VOC/PM or assets/waste list. Real assemblies/collected mixtures need no invented constituents. Unknown applicability, identity, quantity, fate or coverage blocks complete foreground packages and final exchanges; checker pass does not resolve these facts.
table_cell_pairs.zh: 各`cp_expand_`均为清单之外、由其所属节点负责的必需采集要求。每个真实事件均须记录实际发生或有证据支持的未发生，并穷尽具体子项。每个实际子项须有唯一行号，且仅表示一种可识别的产品、配方、总成、功能服务、收集废物流、物质或颗粒分级；同时记录实际方向、类型、状态、接口、原生属性、单位、数量、来源、同节点采集协议、已核UUID、接收方以及全部使用者和供应商覆盖范围。独立识别的替代项和不同环境区室须分别列项；不得绑定要求标签、通用尾气、NOx/VOC/PM合计或资产／废物列表。真实总成或收集混合物无需虚构组成成分。适用性、身份、数量、去向或覆盖范围未知时，阻断完整前景数据包及最终交换的形成；检查通过并不能解决这些事实问题。

table_cell_pairs.en: Before pooling or comparing per-engagement results, record a compatibility decision for every original obligation. Require the same supplied function, compatible actual configuration and hired capacity or capability with native units, equal accepted availability H for the declared per-engagement reference, equivalent acceptance quality, operating versus commercial responsibilities, delivery/redelivery gates, region and duty. Unit conversions require verified support; tolerance may cover evidenced measurement uncertainty only, not different service functions or durations. Different H, incompatible capacity, control, duty or gates remain separate strata unless a documented physical conversion to one explicitly declared common reference is supported for every affected quantity. Count, price, nominal fleet capacity and a shared CPC code never establish equivalence. Missing facts block pooling; one item remains one real original accepted obligation.

Keep ongoing activity with its own obligation for later reconciliation; it is not zero or an accepted fractional item. Failed/cancelled burdens remain separately traceable and enter an accepted cohort only through documented causal pool attribution, never an arbitrary shift to another product or period. table_cell_pairs.en: For each mandatory expansion protocol keep an applicability register owned by its declared node: occurred, evidenced absent or unresolved. An occurred branch has an exhaustive concrete-child list; each child records unique row id, direction/type, actual identity/state/gate, native property/unit/quantity and method, source/receiver/fate, physical transfer id and protocol, exact provider-covered phase/event/site/period cells and asset all-user lifetime attribution where applicable. An absence decision needs dated source records and a bounded node/period/scope; missing evidence is unresolved. Reconcile actual unallocated material, water, carbon and energy ledgers at compatible stock/transform/receiver gates before burden attribution; allocated quantities are not a substitute for physical balance. Internal transfers have paired native amounts and one custody/event owner, not new external supplies or releases. Do not bind protocol labels or fabricate mixture constituents. table_cell_pairs.en: The fixed reference output amount is the normalization definition, not an observed yield distribution. For every other actual inventory row collect an independent compatible reference sample or physical/method constraint before applying a numerical QA guardrail. Record row/node, occurrence conditions, configuration, capacity and H stratum, supplier/state/gate, native unit and conversion evidence, sample source and period, method, bounds and uncertainty. Compare like quantities on the same stated basis; a numerator per engagement cannot be compared directly with a per-hour or per-mass bound. Do not use the validation batch own minimum or maximum to validate itself. A missing compatible numerical range is an unresolved evidence need, not zero, an accepted default or proof of abnormality. Do not invent a universal per-hire interval or replace measurements with a provisional estimate. Every required row-level range decision and supporting evidence must be reviewed before promotion; an unresolved range must remain disclosed.
table_cell_pairs.zh: 固定参考输出量属于归一化定义，不是观测得率分布。对其他每个真实清单行，在采用数值QA护栏前采集独立兼容参考样本或物理方法约束。记录行及节点、发生条件、配置容量与H分层、供应商状态接口、原生单位及换算依据、样本来源期间、方法、上下界及不确定性。仅在相同声明基准上比较同类数量；每次租用的分子不能直接与每小时或每质量上下界比较。不得使用待验证批次自身最小或最大值验证自身。兼容数值范围缺失属于待核证据需求，不是零、已接受默认值或异常的证明。不虚构通用每次租用区间，不以暂定估计替代测量。升级审核状态前须审查每个必需行级范围决策及支持证据；待核范围保持披露。

table_cell_pairs.en: This PCR covers rental services of all types of self-propelled passenger vessels for coastal and transoceanic water transport with crew. The supplied function is making the actual operated passenger vessel or genuinely hired portion available under an evidenced rental engagement, with declared capacity, time, configuration and operating responsibilities. It is not restricted to time charter, one passenger-vessel design, fuel or propulsion technology. A crewed pleasure vessel is not excluded merely because of that label when its actual function meets this passenger-vessel operated-hire scope.

table_cell_pairs.en: Exclude vessels without crew, including no-crew vessel rental/leasing and pleasure-boat rental without crew; exclude inland passenger-vessel hire, freight-vessel hire, operator-only labour, bare asset manufacture and passenger carriage sold as transport to the immediate customer. Invoice wording such as charter, crew presence, passenger occupancy or who pays bunkers alone does not decide the function. Determine the actual supplied availability, operational/navigation control, commercial directions, acceptance and counterparties; necessary hired-vessel crew, operating and support duties remain included. Independent downstream ticket/cruise transport or hotel/entertainment services beyond the hire interface remain separate, while actually owed onboard support is retained.

table_cell_pairs.en: A_x = q_u * D_u * s. q_u is compatible provider inventory per native unit u; D_u is actual same-unit provider demand for the documented serving pool before studied-share attribution; s is the evidenced studied share of that pool. For directly dedicated demand use s = 1 and do not apply another shared fraction. Replace exact covered cells before dividing by N once. No assumption that native hour,vessel-day,Count,cargo tonne-km,tow completion or catch mass or money equals this engagement.
table_cell_pairs.zh: A_x = q_u * D_u * s。q_u为每原生单位u的兼容供应商清单；D_u为有记录服务池在研究份额归属前的真实同单位供应商需求；s为该池有证据的研究份额。直接专属需求取s = 1，不再乘另一共享比例。精确已含项目替代后除N一次，不假定原生小时船日计数货物吨公里、完成拖带或渔获质量金额等于本约定。

table_cell_pairs.en: A_asset = Q_asset * U_studied / U_life;I_asset = A_asset / N. Q_asset is actual native supplied asset quantity;U_studied and positive documented U_life use compatible duty for the same asset and all real users/functions/sites/periods. Availability/capacity-time is declared from actual hire function,not default cargo/tow/catch throughput. Lifecycle phases exclusive;forecast provenance/sensitivity retained. A share of 1 is allowed only when evidence shows that the target hire/cohort accounts for the entire compatible all-user demand of that same asset/event over its relevant life. Reconcile shares across all real users to 1; never default to a whole-asset charge.
table_cell_pairs.zh: A_asset = Q_asset * U_studied / U_life；I_asset = A_asset / N。Q_asset为真实原生供应资产量；U_studied及有记录正值U_life采用同资产全部真实使用者功能场址期间兼容作业。可用容量时间按真实租用功能申明，不默认货物拖带渔获通量。生命周期阶段互斥，保留预测来源敏感性。 仅当证据证明目标租用/队列覆盖同一资产/事件相关寿命内全部兼容使用者需求时，才允许份额为1。全部真实使用者的份额须合计为1；不得默认计入整项资产。

Actual standby can be accepted without movement or occupancy;no universal availability fraction or cancellation threshold.

table_cell_pairs.en: This PCR covers rental services of ALL types of self-propelled freight vessels for coastal and transoceanic water transport WITH CREW, explicitly including tankers, bulk dry cargo vessels, cargo and freight vessels, tugboats and FISHING VESSELS. The immediate supplied function is actual operated vessel availability under a genuine hire obligation, with declared vessel or hired portion, configuration, capacity, time, crew/operator responsibilities and gates. It is not limited to ordinary cargo ships, time charter or one fuel, propulsion, towing or fishing technology. Vessel type alone does not prove the function supplied to the immediate customer. Reference is one independently completed and accepted original operated freight-vessel hire engagement with positive actual accepted availability time H, original or genuinely chronologically amended configuration/capacity/control, region/duty and delivery/redelivery/quality/replacement gates. Count denotes the accepted hire obligation, not a tonne-kilometre, cargo shipment, completed tow, fish catch, voyage, invoice or crew shift. Actual permitted standby may fulfill availability with zero sailing, cargo, towing or catch. Retain H and capacity for coherent comparison and causal attribution; unlike hire durations/configurations/functions are not equivalent merely because each counts as one. An accepted replacement fulfilling the same obligation does not create another reference item.
table_cell_pairs.zh: 本PCR覆盖全部类型配备船员的沿海及远洋运输自航货船出租服务，明确包括油轮、干散货船、货船、拖船及渔船。直接供应功能为真实租用义务下带操作人员船舶可用性，须声明真实船舶或租用部分、配置、容量、时间、船员操作责任及接口。不局限于普通货船、期租或某燃料动力拖带捕捞技术。船型本身不能证明向直接客户供应的功能。参考为一次独立完成并验收的原始带操作人员货船租用约定，具正值真实验收可用时间H，原约或真实时序变更的配置容量控制，以及区域作业、交还船、质量替船接口。计数表示验收租用义务，而非吨公里、货物批次、完成拖带、渔获、航次、账单或换班。真实允许待命可零航行、零载货、零拖带或零渔获而履行可用。保留H容量供一致比较因果归属，不同租时配置功能不能因均计一项即等价。履行同一义务的验收替船不新增参考项。

table_cell_pairs.en: U = opening_stock + receipts - closing_stock - returns - outward_transfers. Include actual initial/customer stock and custody transfers;reconcile actual use/waste. Stock balance alone does not prove consumption or release.

真实归属原生U

table_cell_pairs.en: q_ej = Q_j * d_ej / sum_all_users(d_uj). Denominator must be positive and same-function compatible,covering actual vessel/asset life and all users/functions/periods. Assign initial/replacement/maintenance/retirement/provider cells once. A share of 1 is allowed only when evidence shows that the target hire/cohort accounts for the entire compatible all-user demand of that same asset/event over its relevant life. Reconcile shares across all real users to 1; never default to a whole-asset charge.
table_cell_pairs.zh: q_ej = Q_j * d_ej / sum_all_users(d_uj)。分母须正值及同功能兼容，覆盖真实船舶/资产寿命及全部使用者/功能/期间。初始/更换/维护/退役/供应商项目各归属一次。 仅当证据证明目标租用/队列覆盖同一资产/事件相关寿命内全部兼容使用者需求时，才允许份额为1。全部真实使用者的份额须合计为1；不得默认计入整项资产。

table_cell_pairs.en: actual native Q_j; evidenced all-user demands and exact coverage
table_cell_pairs.zh: 真实原生Q_j；有依据全部使用者需求及精确覆盖
一致租用队列清单

table_cell_pairs.en: q_ref = sum_e(q_e) / N, N > 0. Aggregate only compatible hired configuration/capacity/time/responsibility/gates/waterbody/duty;preserve other strata. Apply reference_compatibility and completed_obligation_cohort before selecting the numerator and N.
table_cell_pairs.zh: q_ref = sum_e(q_e) / N, N > 0。仅汇总兼容所租配置/容量/时间/责任/接口/水体/作业，其他保留分层。 选择分子及N前须执行reference_compatibility与completed_obligation_cohort。

table_cell_pairs.en: E_MJ = E_kWh * 3.6. Use native Net calorific value support and actual point-of-use gate;apply conversion once and account for real losses/provider coverage.

table_cell_pairs.en: This PCR covers rental of all types of self-propelled freight vessels for inland water transport with crew, including tankers, bulk dry cargo vessels, cargo and freight vessels, tugboats and fishing vessels. The supplied function is actual crew-operated vessel availability under an independently accepted hire obligation. It is not limited to vessels carrying their own cargo, successful carriage, towing completion, catch, one propulsion technology or time charter. A tug or fishing vessel can provide the hire function with no cargo or catch aboard. An unpowered barge rented alone is outside this self-propelled scope; an actually provided powered tug-push/convoy configuration must declare the powered vessel and each included barge, equipment and duty interface, without relabelling an unpowered barge as self-propelled.
table_cell_pairs.zh: 本PCR覆盖全部类型配船员的内河运输自航货船出租，包括油船、干散货船、货物运输船、拖船和渔船。所供功能是按独立验收租用义务提供真实带船员操作的船舶可用性。不限于自身载货船、成功承运、拖带完成、捕获渔获、某动力技术或期租。拖船或渔船无船载货物或渔获时仍可提供租用功能。单独出租无动力驳船不在本自航范围；真实提供有动力拖推编队时须申明动力船及各纳入驳船、设备与作业接口，不把无动力驳船改称自航。

table_cell_pairs.en: Exclude vessel rental/leasing without crew (CPC 73115), unpowered-barge-only rental, passenger-vessel hire, coastal/transoceanic freight-vessel hire, operator-only labour and vessel manufacture as the reference product. Independent cargo carriage, cargo production, a sold towing/assistance result and fish capture/production are distinct functions; invoice wording, crew presence, fuel payer or fishing-vessel type alone does not determine the immediate product. Establish actual availability, operational/navigation control, commercial direction, customer, acceptance and interfaces. Actually owed pumping, tank conditioning, tow readiness/gear, fishing-vessel gear/handling, crew and support duties remain in hire attribution; independent downstream functions require separate actual handoff and provider coverage.
table_cell_pairs.zh: 参考产品排除无船员船舶出租租赁（CPC73115）、仅无动力驳船出租、客船出租、沿海远洋货船出租、仅操作人员劳动及船舶制造。独立货物承运、货物生产、出售的拖带协助结果及渔业捕捞生产是不同功能；发票称谓、船员存在、燃料付款者或渔船类型均不能独定直接产品。须核实真实可用性、运行航行控制、商业指令、客户、验收与接口。真实应承担泵送、货舱调理、拖带准备属具、渔船属具处理、船员和支持作业仍归租用；独立下游功能须真实独立交接及供应商覆盖。

table_cell_pairs.en: A_asset = Q_asset * U_studied / U_life;I_asset = A_asset / N. Q_asset is actual native supplied asset quantity;U_studied and positive documented U_life use compatible duty for the same asset and all real users/functions/sites/periods. Availability/capacity-time is declared from actual hire function,not default cargo/catch/tow throughput. Lifecycle phases exclusive;forecast provenance/sensitivity retained. A share of 1 is allowed only when evidence shows that the target hire/cohort accounts for the entire compatible all-user demand of that same asset/event over its relevant life. Reconcile shares across all real users to 1; never default to a whole-asset charge.

en.text: This PCR covers buses and coaches rented with an operator for a period of time, generally not dependent on distance; the renter determines how and when the vehicles operate, including schedules, routes and other operational considerations. The supplied product is actual operated vehicle availability under the original hire obligation. Reference is one independently completed and accepted hire engagement with declared positive actual accepted availability time, vehicle or originally specified fleet, configuration, capacity, operator responsibilities, region/duty and delivery/redelivery gates. Permitted standby can fulfill availability with no passengers or distance. Unlike duration/capacity/control/duty profiles are not equivalent merely because each engagement counts as one.

Exclude local/urban/suburban bus or coach charter services 64118 and long-distance charter 64223, passenger carriage sold as transport, vehicle hire without operator, operator-only labour and asset manufacture. A monthly invoice, whole-vehicle booking, driver presence, distance charge or fuel payer alone does not establish operated rental; verify the actual immediate supplied function and renter operational direction. Independent downstream passenger service remains separate. Actual driver work, preparation, accepted standby, positioning, failure/recovery/replacement and required support stay inside the causal rental boundary. No universal hire, legal, vehicle-size or driver-hours clause is imposed.
Declare every qualifier in actual dataset metadata/reference notes;missing required facts leave the reference incomplete.

All nodes link the same accepted rental engagement. Atomic conditional cards apply only on actual occurrence; mandatory expansion requirements below are not invented exchanges or zero claims. Vehicle replacement, driver shift and downstream trips do not automatically create extra rental output.

Conditional actual generic diesel formulation/gate only; different known grades need their own identity expansion. Include real attributed use/loss and compatible initial/customer-held supply once regardless payer, not all reserve or duplicate purchase/withdrawal.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity / compatible accepted engagement N once
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Actual compatible externally supplied AC at operation/vehicle charging gate only. Charging losses/initial battery energy and upstream gate are recorded; internal generated power, known DC and provider-covered cells excluded.
- Flow property / unit: Net calorific value / MJ
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity / compatible accepted engagement N once
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

One original independently accepted operated rental obligation with positive actual accepted availability time and original vehicle/fleet/configuration/capacity/control/gates/duty. No passenger carriage or manufacture proxy.
- Selected flow: Accepted operated bus or coach hire engagement
- Flow property / unit: Number of items / Item(s)
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow
Actual separately metered external AC for true depot/turnaround/cleaning support gate, distinct from vehicle charging and inclusive provider cells. No duplicate same physical electricity.
- Flow property / unit: Net calorific value / MJ
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity / compatible accepted engagement N once
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow
Actual compatible supplied tapwater product gate only; raw abstraction, collected wastewater and consumption differ and are mandatory expanded where actual. Upstream/distribution coverage explicit.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity / compatible accepted engagement N once
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow
Actual compatible collected used lubricant at generation, treatment separate unless proved covered. Not all workshop waste, oily water, fuel sludge or tyre/brake material.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity / compatible accepted engagement N once
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Qualified Count,availability/capacity-time,native stock/provider/whole-life attribution and mandatory atomic completion are explicit PCR modelling choices. No universal hire duration,occupancy,availability factor,driver resource rate,fuel/emission factor,asset lifetime or recovery credit is supplied. Each cp_expand_ is a mandatory node-owned requirement outside inventory;its unknown actual children remain unresolved until real occurrence/absence and exhaustive verified native child records are complete.

zh.text: 本PCR覆盖配操作驾驶员按一段时间出租巴士及客车，通常不依赖距离；承租方决定车辆如何何时运行及班次路线其他运行事项。所供产品是按原租用义务提供真实带操作车辆可用性。参考为一次独立完成验收租用约定，声明正值真实验收可用时间、车辆或原定车队配置容量操作责任区域作业交还车端口。允许待命可无乘客无距离而履行可用。不同租时容量控制作业画像不能因各计一项就等价。
排除本地城市郊区巴士客车包车服务64118及长途包车64223、作为运输销售的客运、无驾驶员车辆租用、仅操作劳动及资产制造。月账单全车预订驾驶员存在距离收费燃料付款人不能独定带操作租赁；核实真实直接供应功能及承租方运行指令。独立下游客运分开。真实驾驶员工作准备合格待命调位失败救援替车必要支持仍在因果租用边界。不强制通用租约法律车大小驾驶时限条款。

各限定项须在真实数据集元数据参考说明申明；缺少必须事实则参考不完整。
过程图中的`required`表示必须纳入，`foreground`表示前景过程。
全部节点关联同一验收租用约定，条件原子卡仅真实发生适用；下列必须展开要求不是虚构交换或零结论。替车换班下游行程不自动新增租用输出。
仅条件真实通用柴油配方端口，其他已知等级另展开身份。含真实归属使用损失及兼容期初客户供应一次无论付款，不全储备或重复购买提取。

en.text: Covers rental of trucks and other motorized freight vehicles with driver. Establish from the actual agreement and operation that the customer obtains a qualified vehicle-plus-driver availability obligation, with declared renter direction and provider operating responsibility. A rental invoice, fleet type or fuel payer alone does not establish this scope.

Exclude truck rental without driver (CPC 73112), actual road freight carriage (CPC 6511), operator-only labour and vehicle manufacture as reference products. A carrier promising consignment delivery requires the carriage methodology even when called hire; a hired vehicle need not move or carry a positive load while genuinely available under the accepted obligation.

The parent activity is operated road-freight-vehicle hire. Actual rigid, tractor/trailer, body, tailgate, crane, propulsion and duty alternatives change native energy, assets, emissions and records; preserve the evidenced configuration rather than inventing a new product or averaging incompatible duties. Compatible configurations can coexist in a declared fleet; mutually exclusive vehicle states and overlapping obligations must be resolved. Shalom and SPIESS illustrate bounded current commercial configurations and responsibilities only; their advertised sizes, prices and minimum duration are not universal PCR requirements.
Declare every qualifier in reference notes or dataset metadata; missing actual function or qualifier makes the reference incomplete.

The single node owns real operated hire and its attributable lifecycle. Only independently identifiable atomic cards appear below. Unknown variable identities are mandatory collection requirements outside inventory, not aggregate flow exchanges or completed actual inventory.

Only actual supplied diesel of compatible grade/formulation, consumed by the attributable vehicle or supporting operation, whoever pays. Preserve source, stock, use, carbon origin and upstream provider; incompatible actual fuel identities require expansion. No default density or heating value.
- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual externally supplied AC at point of use, irrespective of payer or whether payment occurs. Record provider, geography, mix, voltage, delivery gate, meters and charging/line losses once; direct-current exchanges and incompatible gates need their own identity. Native kWh converts to MJ once using 3.6.
- Flow property / unit: Net calorific value / MJ
- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual treated tap-water supply for attributable cleaning or support, with its native supply gate and quantity. This is neither raw environmental abstraction nor wastewater release. Volume-to-mass conversion needs actual compatible support.
- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only one actual compatible synthetic non-soap cleaning formulation as supplied, including its actual dilution state. Record product/formulation and quantity; do not treat soap, disinfectant or all cleaning products as this identity, or invent constituent exchanges.
- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

One independently accepted qualified operated truck hire engagement at the actual acceptance gate. Retain its original/amended configuration, hired capacity, actual positive accepted availability H, operating responsibility and renter direction; no consignment-delivery, positive-distance or positive-load prerequisite.
- Selected flow: Qualified operated truck hire engagement
- Flow property / unit: Number of items / Item(s)
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only one actual generated and separately collected petroleum-based or synthetic used-lubricating-oil stream at generation. It does not represent oily water, sludge, spent coolant, tyres or mixed workshop wastes. Record actual collection, custody, receiver and fate through mandatory expansion; no automatic recovery credit.
- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual fossil CO2 emitted to air with receiving subcompartment genuinely unspecified. Retain actual fossil share, species mass, source and measurement/calculation evidence; known different subcompartment needs a compatible verified identity. Not total GHG, CO2e, biogenic CO2 or an upstream duplicated emission.
- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Engagement Count, positive accepted availability, native stock/provider/all-user lifetime methods and mandatory atomic-completion gates are explicit PCR modelling choices. No universal price, minimum duration, resource rate, density, emission factor, useful life or recovery credit is supplied. Every cp_expand_ is mandatory even when no inventory card currently represents its actual children.

en.text: This PCR covers rental services of all types of self-propelled passenger vessels for coastal and transoceanic water transport with crew. The supplied function is making the actual operated passenger vessel or genuinely hired portion available under an evidenced rental engagement, with declared capacity, time, configuration and operating responsibilities. It is not restricted to time charter, one passenger-vessel design, fuel or propulsion technology. A crewed pleasure vessel is not excluded merely because of that label when its actual function meets this passenger-vessel operated-hire scope.

The reference is one independently accepted operated passenger-vessel hire engagement, with positive actual accepted availability time and original specified vessel/configuration/capacity, operating responsibility, service region/duty and delivery/redelivery gates. This Count reference denotes the actual availability obligation, not a ticket, passenger journey, kilometre, sailing, vessel asset or invoice installment. Actual permitted standby may fulfill availability without passengers or movement. Record hours and capacity explicitly for comparability and causal attribution; do not split one engagement by billing, crew shift, voyage or an accepted replacement vessel, or merge unlike engagements merely because Count is shared.

Exclude vessels without crew, including no-crew vessel rental/leasing and pleasure-boat rental without crew; exclude inland passenger-vessel hire, freight-vessel hire, operator-only labour, bare asset manufacture and passenger carriage sold as transport to the immediate customer. Invoice wording such as charter, crew presence, passenger occupancy or who pays bunkers alone does not decide the function. Determine the actual supplied availability, operational/navigation control, commercial directions, acceptance and counterparties; necessary hired-vessel crew, operating and support duties remain included. Independent downstream ticket/cruise transport or hotel/entertainment services beyond the hire interface remain separate, while actually owed onboard support is retained.

Record original terms and genuine chronological changes for actual vessel availability, acceptable replacement, off-hire/unavailable periods and service completion. Failed, cancelled, interrupted, positioned or recovered duties retain their real burdens and are not fictitious accepted engagements; payment or contractual off-hire alone is not a physical allocation rule. Actual consumed fuel/energy upstream source supply or charging belongs once to the provided operated function regardless of owner, charterer or customer payment/title, after exact provider reconciliation. This PCR supplies no universal charter clause, manning, safety limit, fuel factor or asset lifetime.
Declare all required qualifiers in dataset metadata or reference notes;missing qualifier makes actual reference incomplete.

Only independently identifiable atomic inventory cards are below. Unknown variable identities are mandatory collection protocols outside inventory,not flow buckets or claimed actual foreground exchanges. Every child remains owned by this real process.

Only actual compatible diesel/gas-oil supplied for this hired vessel at real grade/blend/source native gate. Conditional only: other actual fuels require distinct atomic expansion. Actual consumed opening/customer-owned fuel requires upstream supply once regardless payer/title; supply,withdrawal,burn,spill and retained stock distinct.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Actual compatible external shore AC at a documented meter/loss/provider gate for the operated hire. Not ship-generated electricity, DC, heat or cold. Initial/customer-owned stored energy has actual upstream charging/source once, no free opening energy or duplicate purchase/use.
- Flow property / unit: Net calorific value / kWh
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual compatible supplied tap water at its native gate for owed crew/passenger-vessel support. Not environmental ballast/cooling intake or every treated/saline water. Actual use/stock/waste/direct discharge separate, no inferred density or per-passenger rate.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual R134a product charge supplied to an evidenced hired-vessel refrigeration/HVAC circuit at real native supply gate. Not every refrigerant, all initial charge per hire or leakage quantity; covered initial/service/recovery/retirement cells exclusive.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

One actual independently accepted operated self-propelled passenger-vessel hire engagement for the declared coastal/transoceanic availability obligation. Positive accepted availability time/configuration/capacity/control/gates required; no extra output for standby voyage, invoice, shift, passenger or accepted replacement.
- Selected flow: Accepted operated coastal or transoceanic passenger-vessel hire engagement
- Flow property / unit: Number of items / Item(s)
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual compatible used petroleum/synthetic lubricating oil collected at generation gate, with receiver/treatment separately identified. Not fresh oil, bilge water, sludge, fuel residue or automatic recycling; quantities/provider phases actual once.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual supported fossil CO2 released to air-unspecified at the real source/owner after exact provider coverage. Not fuel mass, CO2e or default all marine CO2; known receiving subcompartment requires its own verified atomic identity.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual evidenced biogenic CO2 air-unspecified release at real source/owner, not every alternative fuel or avoided fossil credit. Known receiving subcompartment must expand own identity; actual carbon-origin quantity and covered provider cell once.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual substance HFC-134a release to air-unspecified from an evidenced R134a circuit, separate initial/service/removed/recovered/retired stock and actual leak measurement/method. Product charge is not release; known compartment requires a different verified identity.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Hire Count,availability/causal pool,native provider/lifetime/stock methods and atomic-completion gate are explicit PCR modelling choices. No universal hire duration,availability fraction,crew/passenger resource rate,fuel/emission factor,asset lifetime or recovery credit is supplied. Actual compatible records and uncertainty are required. All cp_expand_ requirements remain mandatory even where no inventory card currently represents their actual children.

zh.text: 本PCR覆盖全部类型配备船员的沿海及远洋运输自航客船出租服务。所供功能为按有证据租用约定提供真实带操作人员客船或真实租用部分，申明容量时间配置运行责任。不限期租某客船设计燃料动力技术。带船员游乐船真实功能符合本客船带操作人员出租范围时，不仅因该称谓排除。

记录原条款真实按时序变更的船舶可用合格替船停租不可用期间服务完成。失败取消中断调位救援作业保持真实负荷，不虚构验收约定；付款合同停租本身不作物理分配规则。真实消耗燃料能源上游来源供应充电不论船主承租客户付款货权，按精确供应商核对后归属所供带操作功能一次。本PCR不设通用租约条款配员安全限值燃料因子资产寿命。

en.text: This PCR covers rental services of ALL types of self-propelled freight vessels for coastal and transoceanic water transport WITH CREW, explicitly including tankers, bulk dry cargo vessels, cargo and freight vessels, tugboats and FISHING VESSELS. The immediate supplied function is actual operated vessel availability under a genuine hire obligation, with declared vessel or hired portion, configuration, capacity, time, crew/operator responsibilities and gates. It is not limited to ordinary cargo ships, time charter or one fuel, propulsion, towing or fishing technology. Vessel type alone does not prove the function supplied to the immediate customer.

Reference is one independently completed and accepted original operated freight-vessel hire engagement with positive actual accepted availability time H, original or genuinely chronologically amended configuration/capacity/control, region/duty and delivery/redelivery/quality/replacement gates. Count denotes the accepted hire obligation, not a tonne-kilometre, cargo shipment, completed tow, fish catch, voyage, invoice or crew shift. Actual permitted standby may fulfill availability with zero sailing, cargo, towing or catch. Retain H and capacity for coherent comparison and causal attribution; unlike hire durations/configurations/functions are not equivalent merely because each counts as one. An accepted replacement fulfilling the same obligation does not create another reference item.

Exclude rental/leasing of vessels WITHOUT CREW (73115), inland freight-vessel hire, passenger-vessel hire, operator-only labour and vessel manufacture. Distinguish operated availability from freight carriage, a towing outcome or fish production sold as the immediate product. Charter terminology, crew presence, cargo/tow/catch success, or fuel payer alone cannot decide classification. Record actual contract substance, operator/master/crew employment, navigation/maintenance/safety control, commercial directions, counterparties and handoffs. Independent downstream transport, towing or fishing production remains a separate boundary; genuinely owed work and support under the hire remain included.

Keep actual crew/readiness, standby, positioning, sailing/manoeuvring, port/anchor/berth, delivery/redelivery, cleaning, failure/recovery and accepted replacement duties. Include actual cargo/tank/pumping/temperature-control support, towing equipment/work and fishing gear/operation/preservation only where evidenced as owed by the hire; no positive tow, catch or cargo is required. Original duties and genuine amendments retain failed/cancelled/unavailable periods and burdens. Actual consumed fuel/energy and upstream supply/charging, including initial/customer-held stocks, belong once regardless payer/title after exact provider reconciliation. No universal hire clause, manning limit, fuel factor, yield, stock quantity or lifetime is supplied.
Declare all required qualifiers in dataset metadata or reference notes;missing qualifier makes actual reference incomplete.

Only independently identifiable atomic inventory cards are below. Unknown variable identities are mandatory collection protocols outside inventory,not flow buckets or claimed actual foreground exchanges. Every child remains owned by this real process.

Only actual compatible diesel/gas-oil supplied for this hired vessel at real grade/blend/source native gate. Conditional only: other actual fuels require distinct atomic expansion. Actual consumed opening/customer-owned fuel requires upstream supply once regardless payer/title; supply,withdrawal,burn,spill and retained stock distinct.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Actual compatible external shore AC at a documented meter/loss/provider gate for the operated hire. Not ship-generated electricity, DC, heat or cold. Initial/customer-owned stored energy has actual upstream charging/source once, no free opening energy or duplicate purchase/use.
- Flow property / unit: Net calorific value / kWh
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual compatible supplied tap water at its native product gate for actually owed crew/onboard support. Not environmental ballast/cooling intake,all treated/saline water or fish/cargo mass. Actual stock,use,collection/discharge and receiver remain distinct;no assumed density or crew/catch rate.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual R134a product charge supplied to an evidenced hired-vessel refrigeration/HVAC circuit at real native supply gate. Not every refrigerant, all initial charge per hire or leakage quantity; covered initial/service/recovery/retirement cells exclusive.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

One actual independently completed accepted original operated self-propelled freight-vessel hire obligation with crew for declared coastal/transoceanic availability. Positive accepted H and original/genuine amended configuration,capacity,control,region/duty,gates required. No positive sailing,cargo,tow or catch;invoice,shift,voyage or accepted replacement does not create another output.
- Selected flow: Accepted operated coastal or transoceanic freight-vessel hire engagement
- Flow property / unit: Number of items / Item(s)
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual compatible used petroleum/synthetic lubricating oil collected at generation gate, with receiver/treatment separately identified. Not fresh oil, bilge water, sludge, fuel residue or automatic recycling; quantities/provider phases actual once.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual supported fossil CO2 released to air-unspecified at the real source/owner after exact provider coverage. Not fuel mass, CO2e or default all marine CO2; known receiving subcompartment requires its own verified atomic identity.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual evidenced biogenic CO2 air-unspecified release at real source/owner, not every alternative fuel or avoided fossil credit. Known receiving subcompartment must expand own identity; actual carbon-origin quantity and covered provider cell once.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual substance HFC-134a release to air-unspecified from an evidenced R134a circuit, separate initial/service/removed/recovered/retired stock and actual leak measurement/method. Product charge is not release; known compartment requires a different verified identity.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Hire Count,availability/causal pool,native provider/lifetime/stock methods and atomic-completion gate are explicit PCR modelling choices. No universal hire duration,availability fraction,crew/freight resource rate,fuel/emission factor,asset lifetime or recovery credit is supplied. Actual compatible records and uncertainty are required. All cp_expand_ requirements remain mandatory even where no inventory card currently represents their actual children.

en.text: Covers rental services of all types of self-propelled passenger vessels for inland water transport with crew. This includes crewed pleasure craft where the actual immediate supplied function is operated hire. Establish a genuine qualified vessel-plus-crew availability obligation from the agreement and actual operation; a charter label, crew presence, invoice or energy payer alone does not establish hire.

Exclude rental/leasing of vessels without crew (CPC 73115) and inland pleasure boats without crew (CPC 73240). Passenger carriage sold as a ticket, journey or transport undertaking, operator-only labour, vessel manufacture and non-inland hire are outside this reference service. Do not impose a blanket ban on crewed pleasure craft or restrict the category to time charter. A downstream transport service is distinct from the operated hire supplied to it.

The parent activity is actual operated inland passenger-vessel hire. Declare the actual self-propelled vessel, hired configuration/capacity, master/crew and hirer responsibilities, navigation/availability gates, inland waterbody and duty. Compatible vessels or hired capacity can share a declared fleet only with evidenced equivalent function; resolve mutually exclusive vessel states and overlapping obligations. Accepted availability may have zero sailing and zero passengers; empty positioning, genuine standby, hotel/auxiliary demand, failure and accepted replacement remain causal activities.
Declare every qualifier in reference notes or dataset metadata; missing actual function or qualifier makes the reference incomplete.

The single node owns real operated hire and its attributable lifecycle. Only independently identifiable atomic cards appear below. Unknown variable identities are mandatory collection requirements outside inventory, not aggregate flow exchanges or completed actual inventory.

Only actual compatible diesel supplied to propulsion, auxiliary or attributable support, whoever pays. Include consumption from customer-supplied or pre-existing onboard stock; preserve actual grade/formulation, fossil/biogenic source, stock and provider. Other fuel identities require concrete expansion; no default density or heating value.
- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual externally supplied AC at point of use, irrespective of payer or whether payment occurs, including evidenced shore/hotel/charging supply. Declare actual voltage, mix, provider, delivery gate and line/charging losses once. Onboard internally generated electricity is not another purchased AC input; represent its actual fuel/conversion demand once. Different DC or energy identities require expansion.
- Flow property / unit: Net calorific value / MJ
- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual treated tap-water supply for attributable vessel, crew, cleaning or shore support, retaining native quantity and supply gate. It does not represent direct lake/river abstraction, cooling/ballast water, bilge or wastewater discharge. Actual volume-to-mass conversion needs compatible support.
- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only one actual compatible synthetic non-soap cleaning formulation as supplied with its actual dilution state. Record product/formulation and consumed quantity; soap, disinfectant, antifouling coating and all maintenance chemicals are not this identity. Do not invent formulation constituents as exchanges.
- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

One independently accepted qualified self-propelled inland passenger-vessel hire engagement with crew at actual acceptance. Retain original/genuine amended configuration, hired capacity, positive actual accepted availability H, responsibilities, hirer direction, waterbody/duty and delivery/return/replacement gates. No sailing or positive-passenger condition.
- Selected flow: Qualified operated inland passenger-vessel hire engagement
- Flow property / unit: Number of items / Item(s)
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only one actual separately collected generated petroleum-based or synthetic used-lubricating-oil stream at generation. It is not bilge/oily water, sludge, spent coolant, sewage or combined ship wastes. Retain actual mass, custody, transfer, receiver and fate; separately collect actual downstream transport/treatment without default recovery credit.
- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual fossil CO2 species mass emitted to air with genuinely unspecified receiving subcompartment. Preserve carbon origin, actual propulsion/auxiliary/support source and measured or compatible calculation evidence. Known different compartments need compatible identities; not biogenic CO2, total GHG, CO2e or a duplicated upstream emission.
- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Engagement Count, positive accepted availability, native stock/provider/all-user lifetime methods and mandatory atomic-completion gates are explicit PCR modelling choices. No universal price, minimum duration, resource rate, density, emission factor, useful life or recovery credit is supplied. Every cp_expand_ is mandatory even when no inventory card currently represents its actual children.

en.text: This PCR covers rental of all types of self-propelled freight vessels for inland water transport with crew, including tankers, bulk dry cargo vessels, cargo and freight vessels, tugboats and fishing vessels. The supplied function is actual crew-operated vessel availability under an independently accepted hire obligation. It is not limited to vessels carrying their own cargo, successful carriage, towing completion, catch, one propulsion technology or time charter. A tug or fishing vessel can provide the hire function with no cargo or catch aboard. An unpowered barge rented alone is outside this self-propelled scope; an actually provided powered tug-push/convoy configuration must declare the powered vessel and each included barge, equipment and duty interface, without relabelling an unpowered barge as self-propelled.

The reference is one actual independently accepted operated inland freight-vessel hire engagement: 1 Item(s), with positive actual accepted availability time H, original and genuinely amended vessel/configuration, hired capacity or functional capability, operating responsibility, service region/duty and delivery/redelivery/accepted replacement gates. Availability may be fulfilled by actual permitted standby without sailing, cargo, distance, a completed tow or catch. Capacity/capability and time remain mandatory comparability and causal-attribution qualifiers. Do not count invoices, voyages, crew shifts, tow jobs, catch lots or an accepted replacement as extra engagements; genuine independent obligations remain distinct.

Exclude vessel rental/leasing without crew (CPC 73115), unpowered-barge-only rental, passenger-vessel hire, coastal/transoceanic freight-vessel hire, operator-only labour and vessel manufacture as the reference product. Independent cargo carriage, cargo production, a sold towing/assistance result and fish capture/production are distinct functions; invoice wording, crew presence, fuel payer or fishing-vessel type alone does not determine the immediate product. Establish actual availability, operational/navigation control, commercial direction, customer, acceptance and interfaces. Actually owed pumping, tank conditioning, tow readiness/gear, fishing-vessel gear/handling, crew and support duties remain in hire attribution; independent downstream functions require separate actual handoff and provider coverage.

Retain original terms and genuine chronological changes, positive accepted availability, actual off-hire/unavailable/failure/cancellation/recovery and replacement acceptance. Physical burdens survive payment labels and unsuccessful events. Actual fuel/energy upstream supply or charging belongs once to the provided function regardless owner, customer or payer, including actual consumed initial/opening/customer-owned stock. There is no universal inland fuel, freshwater intake, charter clause, legal/manning rule, discharge factor, asset lifetime or invented numerical range here.
Declare all required qualifiers in dataset metadata or reference notes;missing qualifier makes actual reference incomplete.

Only independently identifiable atomic inventory cards are below. Unknown variable identities are mandatory collection protocols outside inventory,not flow buckets or claimed actual foreground exchanges. Every child remains owned by this real process.

Only actual compatible diesel/gas-oil supplied for this hired vessel at real grade/blend/source native gate. Conditional only: other actual fuels require distinct atomic expansion. Actual consumed opening/customer-owned fuel requires upstream supply once regardless payer/title; supply,withdrawal,burn,spill and retained stock distinct.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Actual compatible external shore AC at a documented meter/loss/provider gate for the operated hire. Not ship-generated electricity, DC, heat or cold. Initial/customer-owned stored energy has actual upstream charging/source once, no free opening energy or duplicate purchase/use.
- Flow property / unit: Net calorific value / kWh
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual compatible supplied tap water at its native gate for owed crew/freight-vessel support. Not environmental ballast/cooling intake or every treated/saline water. Actual use/stock/waste/direct discharge separate, no inferred density or per-cargo/tow/catch rate.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual R134a product charge supplied to an evidenced hired-vessel refrigeration/HVAC circuit at real native supply gate. Not every refrigerant, all initial charge per hire or leakage quantity; covered initial/service/recovery/retirement cells exclusive.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

The reference is one actual independently accepted operated inland freight-vessel hire engagement: 1 Item(s), with positive actual accepted availability time H, original and genuinely amended vessel/configuration, hired capacity or functional capability, operating responsibility, service region/duty and delivery/redelivery/accepted replacement gates. Availability may be fulfilled by actual permitted standby without sailing, cargo, distance, a completed tow or catch. Capacity/capability and time remain mandatory comparability and causal-attribution qualifiers. Do not count invoices, voyages, crew shifts, tow jobs, catch lots or an accepted replacement as extra engagements; genuine independent obligations remain distinct.
- Selected flow: Accepted operated inland freight-vessel hire engagement
- Flow property / unit: Number of items / Item(s)
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual compatible used petroleum/synthetic lubricating oil collected at generation gate, with receiver/treatment separately identified. Not fresh oil, bilge water, sludge, fuel residue or automatic recycling; quantities/provider phases actual once.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual supported fossil CO2 released to air-unspecified at the real source/owner after exact provider coverage. Not fuel mass, CO2e or default all marine CO2; known receiving subcompartment requires its own verified atomic identity.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual evidenced biogenic CO2 air-unspecified release at real source/owner, not every alternative fuel or avoided fossil credit. Known receiving subcompartment must expand own identity; actual carbon-origin quantity and covered provider cell once.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual substance HFC-134a release to air-unspecified from an evidenced R134a circuit, separate initial/service/removed/recovered/retired stock and actual leak measurement/method. Product charge is not release; known compartment requires a different verified identity.
- Amount rule: Actual attributed native quantity per accepted hire engagement,normalized once under calculation rules.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Hire Count,availability/causal pool,native provider/lifetime/stock methods and atomic-completion gate are explicit PCR modelling choices. No universal hire duration,availability fraction,crew/operating-support resource rate,fuel/emission factor,asset lifetime or recovery credit is supplied. Actual compatible records and uncertainty are required. All cp_expand_ requirements remain mandatory even where no inventory card currently represents their actual children.

zh.text: 本PCR覆盖全部类型配船员的内河运输自航货船出租，包括油船、干散货船、货物运输船、拖船和渔船。所供功能是按独立验收租用义务提供真实带船员操作的船舶可用性。不限于自身载货船、成功承运、拖带完成、捕获渔获、某动力技术或期租。拖船或渔船无船载货物或渔获时仍可提供租用功能。单独出租无动力驳船不在本自航范围；真实提供有动力拖推编队时须申明动力船及各纳入驳船、设备与作业接口，不把无动力驳船改称自航。
参考为一次真实独立验收的带操作人员内河货船租用约定：1 Item(s)，须有正值真实验收可用时间H、原约及真实变更船舶配置、租用容量或功能能力、运行责任、服务区域作业和交船还船合格替船接口。真实允许待命可在无航行、货物、距离、已完成拖带或渔获时履行可用义务。容量能力与时间仍是必要可比性及因果归属限定。发票、航次、换班、拖带任务、渔获批次及合格替船不额外计约定，真实独立义务保持分开。

参考产品排除无船员船舶出租租赁（CPC73115）、仅无动力驳船出租、客船出租、沿海远洋货船出租、仅操作人员劳动及船舶制造。独立货物承运、货物生产、出售的拖带协助结果及渔业捕捞生产是不同功能；发票称谓、船员存在、燃料付款者或渔船类型均不能独定直接产品。须核实真实可用性、运行航行控制、商业指令、客户、验收与接口。真实应承担泵送、货舱调理、拖带准备属具、渔船属具处理、船员和支持作业仍归租用；独立下游功能须真实独立交接及供应商覆盖。
保留原条款与真实按时序变更、正值验收可用及真实停租不可用故障取消救援替船验收。付款标签和失败事件不能消除物理负荷。真实燃料能源上游供应充电不论所有者客户付款者归所供功能一次，包括真实消耗初始期初客户库存。本PCR不设通用内河燃料、淡水摄取、租约条款、法律配员规则、排出因子、资产寿命或虚构数值范围。

en.text: Covers rental services of passenger aircraft or aircraft suitable for passenger and freight,including helicopters,with crew. Preserve the full category across actual aircraft types,propulsion and configurations;not limited to jets,airlines,a provider brand or a complete ACMI insurance/maintenance bundle. Determine that the immediate supplied function is qualified aircraft-plus-crew availability from the original/genuine amended agreement and actual operation.

Passenger/freight suitable aircraft are assigned from the actual offered hire function,original cohort,configuration/hired capacity,roles and gates;aircraft type,payload on one flight,invoice title or flight number alone cannot classify dual use. Resolve an ambiguous or mixed-function obligation explicitly without silently choosing a passenger or freight category or counting the same hire twice. Ticketed passenger carriage or freight carriage sold as consignment transport,bare aircraft lease,crew-only labour and aircraft manufacture are outside this reference service.

Passenger-and-freight suitability must be evidenced for the actual hired configuration and accepted function; it does not require both passengers and freight to move. A freight-only hire outside this passenger or combined-suitability boundary needs its own applicable PCR.

The parent activity is actual crewed passenger or passenger-and-freight-suitable aircraft hire. These services are generally time-based and frequently involve several destinations;neither statement creates a minimum flight,leg,destination,load or distance gate. Qualified accepted standby may have zero flights,zero passengers and zero payload. Declare lessor/operator technical,AOC and captain safety responsibility separately from lessee commercial programme/directions as actually supplied;commercial direction does not imply technical control. Positioning/ferry,diversion,ground/APU work,off-hire failure,recovery,substitute and return remain causal activities.
Declare every qualifier in reference notes or dataset metadata; missing actual function or qualifier makes the reference incomplete.

The single node owns real operated hire and its attributable lifecycle. Only independently identifiable atomic cards appear below. Unknown variable identities are mandatory collection requirements outside inventory, not aggregate flow exchanges or completed actual inventory.

Only actual externally supplied AC, irrespective of payer or whether payment occurs, at its point-of-use gate for attributable aircraft,charging,ground or airport support. Record source/provider,mix,voltage,meters and delivery/conversion losses once. Onboard/APU or internally generated electricity is not another purchased AC input;actual fuel/transformation demand is recorded once. Different DC/energy identities require concrete expansion.
- Flow property / unit: Net calorific value / MJ
- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual treated tap-water supply for attributable aircraft,crew,cleaning or ground/airport support,retaining native quantity and supply gate. It is not direct environmental intake,deicing formulation,collected effluent or an emitted water substance. Actual volume-to-mass conversion requires compatible evidence.
- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only one actual compatible synthetic non-soap cleaning formulation as supplied at its real dilution state. Record product/formulation and consumed native mass. Soap,disinfectant,deicing/anti-icing fluid and other maintenance formulations require their own identity;do not invent ingredient exchanges.
- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

One independently accepted originally bounded qualified passenger or passenger-and-freight-suitable aircraft-with-crew hire obligation,including helicopter hire when actually supplied. Retain original/genuine amended function/cohort,aircraft/configuration/hired capacity,positive actual accepted H,technical/AOC/captain versus commercial roles,quality/gates/region/duty. No positive flight,leg,passenger,payload or carriage-delivery success condition.
- Selected flow: Qualified crewed passenger or passenger-and-freight-suitable aircraft hire engagement
- Flow property / unit: Number of items / Item(s)
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only one actual separately collected generated petroleum-based or synthetic used-lubricating-oil stream at generation. It is not fuel residue,deicing/cleaning effluent,hydraulic-fluid waste,sludge or all aircraft wastes. Record real mass,storage/custody,transfer,receiver and downstream treatment/fate once;no assumed recovery credit.
- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual fossil CO2 species mass from an identified aircraft/APU/ground/support source whose receiving air subcompartment is genuinely unspecified. Retain actual source,flight phase and known altitude as evidence;these facts alone do not require another UUID. Determine receiving-compartment compatibility from the verified native flow definition and actual receiver evidence. A known incompatible receiver requires its own compatible verified UUID and separately quantified row;never merge different receiving compartments. Use air-unspecified only for a genuinely unspecified receiver with supported native compatibility;unresolved compatibility blocks completion at the actual row_id. Not all flight CO2,total GHG,CO2e,biogenic carbon or duplicated upstream emissions.
- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Engagement Count, positive accepted availability, native stock/provider/all-user lifetime methods and mandatory atomic-completion gates are explicit PCR modelling choices. No universal price, minimum duration, resource rate, density, emission factor, useful life or recovery credit is supplied. Every cp_expand_ is mandatory even when no inventory card currently represents its actual children.

zh.text: 涵盖配机组的客运航空器或适合客货两用航空器租赁，包括直升机。保留实际机型、动力及配置的完整类别，不限于喷气机、航空公司、供应商品牌或完整ACMI保险/维护组合。须依原约/真实变更约定及实际运行确认即时所供功能为合格航空器及机组可用性。
适客货两用航空器依实际所供租用功能、原队列、配置/所租容量、角色及接口判定；仅机型、一次飞行载荷、发票名或航班号不能判定两用功能。须明确消解模糊或混合功能义务，不静默选择客运或货运类别或将同一租用计两次。按票销售的客运或按货物承运销售的货运、航空器光租、仅机组劳动及航空器制造不属于本参考服务。
客货两用适合性须由实际所租配置及验收功能证明，不要求旅客和货物都发生运输。不在客运或客货两用适合性边界内的纯货运租用须采用自身适用PCR。
母活动为真实配机组客运或适客货两用航空器租用。此类服务一般按时间供应且常涉及多个目的地，两者均不构成最低飞行、航段、目的地、载荷或距离门。合格验收待命可为零飞行、零旅客及零载荷。按实际供应分别申明出租/运行方技术、AOC及机长安全责任与承租人商业计划/指令；商业指令不等于技术控制。调位/转场、备降、地面/APU工作、停租故障、救援、替机及归还仍为因果活动。
分类引用中的`exact`表示精确映射。
在参考说明或数据集元数据申明全部限定项，真实功能或限定项缺失则参考不完整。
过程图中的`required`表示必须纳入，`foreground`表示前景过程。
本单一节点拥有真实配机组航空器租用及其归属生命周期。以下仅可独立识别原子卡。未知变量身份为清单外必须采集要求，非聚合流交换或已完成真实清单。

Passenger/freight suitable aircraft are assigned from the actual offered hire function,original cohort,configuration/hired capacity,roles and gates;aircraft type,payload on one flight,invoice title or flight number alone cannot classify dual use. Resolve an ambiguous or mixed-function obligation explicitly without silently choosing freight or counting the same hire twice. Freight carriage sold as consignment transport,bare aircraft lease,crew-only labour and aircraft manufacture are outside this reference service.

The parent activity is actual crewed freight-aircraft hire. These services are generally time-based and frequently involve several destinations;neither statement creates a minimum flight,leg,destination,load or distance gate. Qualified accepted standby may have zero flights and zero cargo. Declare lessor/operator technical,AOC and captain safety responsibility separately from lessee commercial programme/directions as actually supplied;commercial direction does not imply technical control. Positioning/ferry,diversion,ground/APU work,off-hire failure,recovery,substitute and return remain causal activities.
Declare every qualifier in reference notes or dataset metadata; missing actual function or qualifier makes the reference incomplete.

The single node owns real operated hire and its attributable lifecycle. Only independently identifiable atomic cards appear below. Unknown variable identities are mandatory collection requirements outside inventory, not aggregate flow exchanges or completed actual inventory.

Only actual externally supplied AC, irrespective of payer or whether payment occurs, at its point-of-use gate for attributable aircraft,charging,ground or airport support. Record source/provider,mix,voltage,meters and delivery/conversion losses once. - Flow property / unit: Net calorific value / MJ
- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

- Selected flow: Qualified crewed freight-aircraft hire engagement

- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

Only actual fossil CO2 species mass from an identified aircraft/APU/ground/support source whose receiving air subcompartment is genuinely unspecified. Retain actual source,flight phase and known altitude as evidence;these facts alone do not require another UUID. Determine receiving-compartment compatibility from the verified native flow definition and actual receiver evidence. Use air-unspecified only for a genuinely unspecified receiver with supported native compatibility;unresolved compatibility blocks completion at the actual row_id. Not all flight CO2,total GHG,CO2e,biogenic carbon or duplicated upstream emissions.
- Amount rule: Actual attributable native quantity per declared accepted hire reference, normalized once under section 8.
- Normalization basis: per declared reference flow

changes.canonical_english: Every cp_expand_ is a mandatory node-owned collection requirement outside inventory. For each real event require occurrence or evidenced absence and an exhaustive child register; each actual child has unique row, single identifiable product/formulation/assembly/functional service/collected waste/substance or particle fraction, actual direction/type/state/gate/native property/unit/quantity/source/same-node protocol, verified UUID, receiver and all-user/provider coverage. Unknown applicability, identity, quantity, fate or coverage blocks complete foreground packages and final exchanges; checker pass does not resolve these facts.
changes.before_chinese: 各`cp_expand_`为清单外必需同节点采集要求。逐真实事件须发生或有据未发生及穷尽子登记；逐实际子项唯一行单一可识别产品配方总成功能服务收集废物流物质粒径、真实方向类型状态端口原生属性单位数量来源同节点协议已核UUID接收全用户供应范围。分独立身份替代物环境子介质，不绑要求标签总尾气NOx/VOC/PM或资产废物列表。真实总成收集混合物不虚构组分。适用身份数量去向范围未知阻断完整前景包最终交换；检查通过不解决事实。
changes.after_chinese: 各`cp_expand_`均为清单之外、由其所属节点负责的必需采集要求。每个真实事件均须记录实际发生或有证据支持的未发生，并穷尽具体子项。每个实际子项须有唯一行号，且仅表示一种可识别的产品、配方、总成、功能服务、收集废物流、物质或颗粒分级；同时记录实际方向、类型、状态、接口、原生属性、单位、数量、来源、同节点采集协议、已核UUID、接收方以及全部使用者和供应商覆盖范围。独立识别的替代项和不同环境区室须分别列项；不得绑定要求标签、通用尾气、NOx/VOC/PM合计或资产／废物列表。真实总成或收集混合物无需虚构组成成分。适用性、身份、数量、去向或覆盖范围未知时，阻断完整前景数据包及最终交换的形成；检查通过并不能解决这些事实问题。

changes.canonical_english: For every actual substance/fraction,measure or use a compatible evidenced calculation at actual technology,duty,carbon origin and receiving compartment. changes.after_chinese: 对每种实际物质或组分，按真实技术、作业、碳源和接收区室进行测量，或采用有证据支持的兼容计算方法。总生成量、库存留存量、捕集量、转移量及实际释放量须按互斥去向核对闭合；原始尾气、NOx、VOC或PM合计不等于逐物质质量。收集废物流不等于其组成成分已排入环境；CO2e不等于CO2质量。
